g.text: Synchronous requests are solid; asynchronous (database-mediated) work is dashed
Application host — Docker Compose (trust boundary: HTTPS only from outside)
GPU host — worker side (same machine as the application host in local academic deployment)
Colours: blue = user/front end, green = API/application,
amber = database/storage, purple = AI/GPU, grey = infrastructure.
No message broker: the job queue is the animation_job table (PostgreSQL).
The browser never talks to the database or media store directly.
The GPU worker has no API endpoint; it only polls the database and reads/writes media.
Plan interpreter location (GPU host vs API process) is an open implementation decision (D-18).
